DILG BAGONG PILIPINAS Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA cor. Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City s. 2021 DILG OPINION NO. 35 MAR 08 sus MR. CROMWELL A. DAVEY Head, Branch Policy Support Unit CDAVEY@Iandbank.com Dear Mr. Davey: This has reference to your e-mail dated November 15, 2023 regarding DILG Memorandum Circular No. 2023-1661, specifically on whether "bonuses" are covered by the term "salaries and honorarium" To give context thereto, may we quote in full the provision of DILG MC No. 2023-166 subject of your query: OUTGOING BARANGAY AND SK OFFICIALS "3. 3.3 When necessary and when the newly elected officials of the barangay have not yet completely assumed office, ensure ppvment of recurrinq Ieqitimate obliqations of the baranqay. particularly utilitv bills. salaries and honorarium only (barangay officials/employees only)." (Emphasis Supplied) In this afore-quoted provision, please notice the following: a) Before the phrase "particularly utility bills, salaries and honorarium, " there was a phrase mentioned— "recurring legitimate obligations of the barangay"; and b) The word "particularly" was used prior to enumerating "utility bills, salaries and honorarium". "Recurring legitimate obligations" refers to those that should be paid or settled at fixed and regular intervals. Taking this into account, what is being mandated for the outgoing barangay and SK officials to do under the afore-quoted provision of the DILG MC is to ensure continuous payment of those fixed and regular obligations of the barangay. Note that the use of the word "particularly" does not limit those fixed and regular obligations of the barangay to the enumerated utility bills, salaries and honorarium. The word "particularly" was used to emphasize that the recurring legitimate obligations of the barangay are predominantly utility bills, salaries and honorarium. 1 Entitled *GUIDANCE ON THE ASSUMPTION OF OFFICE OF THE BARANGAY AND SK OFFICIALS ELECTED ON OCTOBER 30, 2023 SYNCHORNIZED "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline NO. (02) 6676 3454

This legal opinion is based solely on the representations you made in your letter and that the issuance thereof is without prejudice to the order of the proper courts and fora. We hope to have provided you guidance on the matter. Thank you. Very truly yours, AUT ORITY OF THE SECRETARY: JUAN VICTOR LLAMAS n rsecretary for External, Legal and Legislative Affairs/ SELLA/JVRL/LRALLD/clp Page 2 of 2
